title: ID0422690-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001822] Broken Display
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The screen of the charger stays black, the display is broken. Our
tech performed a reboot on site and it didn't help. The LEDs on the
side were blue, like they normally are. We were able to start both
sessions on plug a and b through our Sparki app.
Please replace the screen asap.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0422690-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001822] Broken Display CRM:02679000233
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-BE Team,
As reported,
“The screen of the charger stays black; the display is broken.”
We recommend planning a site visit and performing the following checks during the visit:
Actions to Perform On-Site:
Verify Screen Issue:
Check whether the screen is completely black or if it's just a blacklight issue. If there is backlight, refer to the Q feedback below for troubleshooting.
Link:
SI E Q-Feedback Q2302 Sicharge D - HMI Backlight Off and Scrambled Image Due to R... - ID: 109816666 - Industry Support Siemens
Connection Inspection:
Verify all connections between KF1 and PH2 to ensure there are no loose connections.
Confirm the integrity of DPP and USB connections for the OC display and touchscreen functionality.
Voltage Check:
Measure the supply voltage and ensure it is delivering a stable 24V.
Cable Testing:
Swap the DPP and USB cables with known working ones to rule out cable faults.
Firmware Validation:
Ensure the D-Logic controller is updated to the latest firmware.
Electrical & Wiring Checks:
Verify if FC-12 in the automation area has tripped.
Inspect all wiring associated with the HMI and D-Logic controller for potential issues.
PCB Handling:
During updates or interventions, ensure the PCB is firmly connected. Handle the flat ribbon cable with care to avoid damage.
Site Visit Preparation:
Please ensure the spare parts HMI, DPP and USB cable are available during the visit for replacement, if necessary.
For guidance, refer to the attached HMI schematic.
When ordering spare parts, please consider the type of existing control panel to ensure compatibility with the new HMI. For your reference, kindly review the parts listed below.
Since no more DLogic Gen1 units are available anymore, replacing such a control panel needs the corresponding DLogic Gen2 unit plus an adaptation set.
Direct replacement of 8EM5903-0AA01-7AA0 requires material 8EM5903-0AA04-0AA0 and the adaptation set 8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6.
Note-Before order please confirm once with existing, if it is gen1 then adaptation set requires.
